title: Colonel JD AI Codec Conversation MGS2 HD
summary: The final codec conversation from Metal Gear Solid 2, in which the AI 'Colonel' explains that the Patriots filter out junk information and curate truth for humanity. It plays as a dark meditation on information overload, manipulation and shared reality.
why: Commenters point to it whenever AI-generated content, propaganda or internet garbage comes up, since Kojima seemed to predict it in 2001.

quote.text: You should play Metal Gear Solid 2, or at least watch the last codec call[1].
